author: Ning Zhang

steps.title: Deparaffinize and hydrate sections
steps.instruction: Incubate sections sequentially in the following solutions:

substeps.instruction: Three washes of xylene, 5 min each
Two washes of 100 % ethanol, 10 min each
Two washes of 95 % ethanol, 10 min each

steps.title: Rinse in distilled water
steps.instruction: Wash sections twice in distilled H₂O for 5 min each.

steps.title: Quench endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in 3 % hydrogen peroxide for 10 min.

steps.title: Wash in buffer
steps.instruction: Wash sections in wash buffer for 5 min.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Add 100–400 µL blocking solution to each section and incubate 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Apply primary antibody
steps.instruction: Remove blocking solution, add 100–400 µL primary antibody diluted in the recommended diluent, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash sections in wash buffer three times, 5 min each.

steps.title: Add biotinylated secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100–400 µL biotinylated secondary antibody diluted in TBST (per manufacturer) and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare ABC reagent (if used)
steps.instruction: If using the ABC avidin/biotin method, prepare ABC reagent according to the manufacturer’s instructions and incubate the solution 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash sections three times with wash buffer, 5 min each.

steps.title: Add ABC reagent
steps.instruction: Add 100–400 µL ABC reagent to each section and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after ABC
steps.instruction: Wash sections three times in wash buffer for 5 min each.

steps.title: Develop with DAB
steps.instruction: Add 100–400 µL DAB or suitable substrate to each section, monitor staining closely, and as soon as the sections develop, immerse slides in distilled water.

steps.title: Counterstain (optional)
steps.instruction: If desired, counterstain sections in hematoxylin according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Final water washes
steps.instruction: Wash sections in distilled water two times for 5 min each.

steps.title: Mount coverslips
steps.instruction: Mount coverslips onto the dehydrated sections.
